messages.subject: Median on boxplot is indistinguishable from quartiles
parts:
Hi Party People,

Is there a way to get a thicker or different colored line for the
median of a boxplot, in case it coincides with one of the quartiles?

Thanks,

Patricio

messages.author: 4e69b94a09c8cf3b
messages.subject: Re: Median on boxplot is indistinguishable from quartiles
parts:
How about something such as

p + geom_boxplot() +
stat_summary(fun.y=median, fun.ymin=median, fun.ymax=median,
geom="crossbar", color="red")
